arxiv-2109-11588.title: Relationships between some selection principles and star selection principles
arxiv-2109-11588.creator: JAVIER CASAS-DE LA ROSA
arxiv-2109-11588.description: Abstract Motivated by the definition of classical star selection principles, some selection principles were defined in [ 7 ] , as well as several questions about relationships between the notions defined there with the classical star selection principles were posed. In this paper, we answer the questions posed in [ 7 ] .

arxiv-2206-11265.title: On Fuzzy Cardinal Semantic Transformations
arxiv-2206-11265.creator: Alexander Yu. Chunikhin, Vadym Zhytniuk
arxiv-2206-11265.description: Abstract The concept of fuzzy cardinal semantic transformation as a basis for creating fuzzy semantic numeration systems is introduced in this work. Both fuzziness of the initial data - cardinals of abstract entities - and fuzziness of the parameters of the cardinal semantic operators are considered.

arxiv-2312-15887.title: Homogenization of the first initial-boundary value problem for periodic hyperbolic systems. Principal term of approximation 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. Primary 35B27. Secondary 35L53.
arxiv-2312-15887.creator: Yulia Meshkova
arxiv-2312-15887.description: Abstract Let 𝒪 ⊂ ℝ d \mathcal{O}\subset\mathbb{R}^{d} be a bounded domain of class C 1 , 1 C^{1,1} . In L 2 ​ ( 𝒪 , ℂ n ) L_{2}(\mathcal{O};\mathbb{C}^{n}) , we consider a matrix elliptic second order differential operator A D , ε A_{D,\varepsilon} with the Dirichlet boundary condition. Here ε > 0 \varepsilon>0 is a small parameter.

arxiv-2408-04285.title: Classifying the surface-knot modules
arxiv-2408-04285.creator: Akio Kawauchi
arxiv-2408-04285.description: Abstract The k k th module of a surface-knot of a genus g g in the 4-sphere is the k k th integral homology module of the infinite cyclic covering of the surface-knot complement. The reduced first module is the quotient module of the first module by the finite sub-module defining the torsion linking.

arxiv-2505-18499.title: G1 : Teaching LLMs to Reason on Graphs with Reinforcement Learning Thanks: School of CIT, MCML, MDSI Thanks: EECS and CSAIL
arxiv-2505-18499.creator: Xiaojun Guo, Ang Li *, Yifei Wang *, Stefanie Jegelka, Yisen Wang
arxiv-2505-18499.description: Abstract Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress, their proficiency in graph-related tasks remains notably limited, hindering the development of truly general-purpose models. Previous attempts, including pretraining graph foundation models or employing supervised fine-tuning, often face challenges such as the scarcity of large-scale, universally represented graph data.

arxiv-2506-09289.title: UTBoost: Rigorous Evaluation of Coding Agents on SWE-Bench
arxiv-2506-09289.creator: Boxi Yu, Yuxuan Zhu, Pinjia He, Daniel Kang
arxiv-2506-09289.description: Abstract The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) has spurred the development of coding agents for real-world code generation. As a widely used benchmark for evaluating the code generation capabilities of these agents, SWE-Bench uses real-world problems based on GitHub issues and their corresponding pull requests.

arxiv-2509-18235.title: Automated Analysis of Naturalistic Recordings in Early Childhood: Applications, Challenges, and Opportunities
arxiv-2509-18235.creator: Jialu Li, Marvin Lavechin, Xulin Fan, Nancy L. McElwain, Alejandrina Cristia, Paola Garcia-Perera, Mark Hasegawa-Johnson
arxiv-2509-18235.description: Abstract Naturalistic recordings capture audio in real-world environments where participants behave naturally without interference from researchers or experimental protocols. Naturalistic long-form recordings extend this concept by capturing spontaneous and continuous interactions over extended periods, often spanning hours or even days, in participants’ daily lives.

arxiv-2510-22386.title: On the complexity of the free space of a translating square in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3}
arxiv-2510-22386.creator: Gabriel Nivasch
arxiv-2510-22386.description: Abstract Consider a polyhedral robot B B that can translate (without rotating) amidst a finite set of non-moving polyhedral obstacles in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} . The free space ℱ \mathcal{F} of B B is the set of all positions in which B B is disjoint from the interior of every obstacle.

pmc-10623107.title: Anatomical external auricular muscle transposition with mini flap transfer for mild cryptotia: A case report
pmc-10623107.creator: Kosuke Yamagata, Chihena H. Banda, Makoto Shiraishi, Kotaro Shimizu, Yoshimoto Okada, Kohei Mitsui, Kanako Danno, Ryohei Ishiura, Hiroshi Furukawa, Mitsunaga Narushima
pmc-10623107.description: Cryptotia is a congenital ear deformity characterized by the upper helix buried under the skin of the temporal region. Recurrence and inadequate correction of ear position are major complications following auricle reconstruction. Abnormalities of the auricular muscles are closely associated with cryptotia and considered to be the main cause.

pmc-10696851.title: Mesenchymal stem cells-derived extracellular vesicles protect against oxidative stress-induced xenogeneic biological root injury via adaptive regulation of the PI3K/Akt/NRF2 pathway
pmc-10696851.creator: Haojie Fu, Lin Sen, Fangqi Zhang, Sirui Liu, Meiyue Wang, Hongyan Mi, Mengzhe Liu, Bingyan Li, Shumin Peng, Zelong Hu, Jingjing Sun, Rui Li
pmc-10696851.description: Xenogeneic extracellular matrices (xECM) for cell support have emerged as a potential strategy for addressing the scarcity of donor matrices for allotransplantation. However, the poor survival rate or failure of xECM-based organ transplantation is due to the negative impacts of high-level oxidative stress and inflammation on seed cell viability and stemness.

pmc-10704965.title: Elevated prostate-specific antigen in Paget’s disease
pmc-10704965.creator: Shrikant Vasantrao Solav, Manohar Inamdar, Shailendra V. Savale
pmc-10704965.description: A 70-year-old man diagnosed with acinar adenocarcinoma prostate (Gleason score 4 + 4 = 8) underwent bone scintigraphy due to high serum prostate-specific antigen level (224 ng/mL; normal <4 ng/mL). Bone scan revealed moderately increased diffuse tracer uptake in the right hemipelvis, while the rest of the scan appeared normal, leading to suspicion of Paget’s disease.

pmc-11460017.title: NEK10 kinase ablation affects mitochondrial morphology, function and protein phosphorylation status
pmc-11460017.creator: Andressa Peres de Oliveira, Claudia D. C. Navarro, Pedro Rafael F. Dias, Tania Arguello, Brittni R. Walker, Sandra R. Bacman, Lizandra Maia Sousa, Roger F. Castilho, Sílvio R. Consonni, Carlos T. Moraes, Jörg Kobarg
pmc-11460017.description: BackgroundNEK10, a serine/threonine/tyrosine kinase belonging to the NEK (NIMA-related kinases) family, has been associated with diverse cellular processes. However, no specific target pathways have been identified. Our previous work knocking down NEK10 in HeLa cells suggested a functional association with mitochondria, as we observed altered mitochondrial morphology, mitochondrial oxygen consumption, mtDNA integrity, and reactive oxygen species levels.

pmc-12594649.title: Fungal Infections – a Stealthy Enemy in Patients with Chronic Granulomatous Disease: a 28-years’ Experience from North India
pmc-12594649.creator: Pandiarajan Vignesh, Sanjib Mondal, Ridhima Aggarwal, Sangeetha Siniah, Sathish Kumar Loganathan, Dharmagat Bhattarai, Jhumki Das, Sumit Goel, Kaushal Sharma, Harsimran Kaur, Aravind Sekar, Manpreet Dhaliwal, Saniya Sharma, Rakesh Kumar Pilania, Ankur Kumar Jindal, Deepti Suri, Kirti Gupta, Shivapra
pmc-12594649.description: Fungal infections contribute to a significant disease burden in patients with chronic granulomatous disease (CGD). While the presentation may differ depending on genotype and environmental exposure to fungus, associated mortality rates are universally high. This is a retrospective study wherein medical records of patients diagnosed with CGD from 1994 to 2022 at our center in North India were reviewed.

pmc-13265168.title: Translation is not exportation: why European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition rewrites the 4Kscore story
pmc-13265168.creator: Whi-An Kwon
pmc-13265168.description: biopsies while maintaining detection of clinically significant disease. The 4Kscore (OPKO Diagnostics), which integrates four kallikrein markers [total prostate-specific antigen (PSA), free PSA, intact PSA, and human kallikrein-related peptidase 2 (hK2)] with age and clinical variables as originally intended, was developed explicitly for this short-horizon decision problem.

pmc-13397629.title: Everyday discrimination and life satisfaction: Turkish adaptation of the Everyday Discrimination Scale (EDS) and the mediating role of depression
pmc-13397629.creator: Nilüfer Kuru
pmc-13397629.description: BackgroundPerceived discrimination is recognized as a chronic psychosocial stressor associated with adverse mental health outcomes and reduced well-being. However, the psychological mechanisms linking discrimination to life satisfaction remain insufficiently explored in non-Western contexts, and validated measures of everyday discrimination in Türkiye are limited.

pmc-13434641.title: Active learning-guided mechanistic modeling reveals context-specific regulators of CXCL9 expression in pancreatic cancer cells
pmc-13434641.creator: Bi-rong Wang, Maaruthy Yelleswarapu, Lucie Descamps, Federica Eduati
pmc-13434641.description: Cold tumors like pancreatic cancer suffer from poor immune infiltration, limiting effective anti-tumor responses. The chemokine CXCL9 promotes immune cell recruitment, but the signaling mechanisms regulating its expression in tumor cells remain poorly understood and underexplored as targets for modulation.

pmc-13473323.title: Is watchful waiting an alternative to adenotonsillectomy in children with mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnoea?
pmc-13473323.creator: Stefan Kuhle, Christian F Poets, Michael S Urschitz
pmc-13473323.description: Adenotonsillectomy (ATE) has traditionally been the first-line treatment for obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) in children. Increasing evidence suggests that many children with mild to moderate OSA may improve without surgery. This mini-review examines whether watchful waiting is a safe and effective alternative to ATE in otherwise healthy children with mild to moderate OSA.
